unknownSchool.title: We couldn't find this school
unknownSchool.body: Check the address, or look up your school with your email.

unavailable.title: We can't reach the school right now
unavailable.body: This is on our side. Please try again in a minute.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page has moved.

validation.slugReserved: This address is reserved. Try another.

authErrors.invalidCredentials: That email or phone number and password don't match an account at this school.
authErrors.accountLocked: Too many wrong passwords. You can try again after {time}.
authErrors.accountPending: This account isn't verified yet. Use the link in your invitation or verification email.
authErrors.accountBlocked: This account can't sign in. Contact your school office.
authErrors.membershipPending: Your invitation hasn't been accepted yet. Open the activation link in your invitation email.
authErrors.accessEnded: You no longer have access to this school. Contact your school office.
authErrors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
authErrors.passwordChangeRequired: Please change your password to continue.
authErrors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired.
authErrors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
authErrors.network: We can't reach the server right now. Check your connection and try again.
authErrors.handoff: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please sign in here.
authErrors.googleNoAccount: There's no account at this school for that Google account. Sign in with your email or phone instead.
authErrors.googleEmailUnverified: Google hasn't verified that email address, so we can't use it to sign you in.
authErrors.googleExpired: Google sign-in took too long. Please try again.
authErrors.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
authErrors.googleDisabled: Google sign-in isn't available right now.
authErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
authErrors.googleEmailMismatch: Use the email address you signed in to Google with.
authErrors.googleAlreadyLinked: That Google account is already linked to another account.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: For staff, students and guardians of {school}.
login.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.invited: Got an invitation? Open the link in the email to set up your account.

activate.title: Set up your account
activate.existingDescription: {account} already has a password. Enter it to accept the invitation.
activate.invalidBody: It may be used already or expired. Ask your school to send a new invitation.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your account's email. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If {email} belongs to an account at this school, a link to reset the password is on its way.
forgot.phoneOnly: Sign in with a phone number? Ask your school office to reset your password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: For {account}. You'll be signed out on every device.
reset.invalidBody: It may be used already or expired. Ask for a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Confirm that {email} is your email address.
verify.invalidBody: It may be used already or expired. Sign in to ask for a new one.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.forcedDescription: Your password was set by someone else. Choose your own to continue.
changePassword.description: You'll stay signed in here; your other devices are signed out.

settingUp.title: Your school is being set up
settingUp.body: {school}'s administrators are still setting things up. You can start using {brand} as soon as they finish.
settingUp.stillOpen: Not ready yet. Please check again later.

signedIn.title: You're signed in
signedIn.body: Signed in as {name}. This part of {brand} is on its way.

signup.title: Create your school
signup.description: 30 days of Standard, free, with no card.
signup.googleVerified: Google verified {email}. Fill in the rest to create your school.
signup.slugHint: Staff, students and guardians sign in here. You can change it later.
signup.trial: By creating a school you start a 30-day trial. No payment details needed.
signup.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to create your school; it works for 24 hours.
signup.verifyDescription: Press the button to create your school and sign in.
signup.invalidBody: It may be used already or expired. Start again; it only takes a minute.

findSchool.title: Find your school
findSchool.description: Each school signs in on its own address. Enter it, or let us email it to you.
findSchool.addressDescription: You'll find it on your invitation or sign-in slip.
findSchool.emailDescription: We'll email you a sign-in link for each school you belong to.
findSchool.sentBody: If {email} has an account, we've sent it a link to each of its schools.

userMenu.label: Account menu for {name}
userMenu.switchFailed: Couldn't open that school. Try again.

home.title: Welcome
home.body: Everything you can open at this school.
home.noMenus: Your account has no menus yet. Ask your school admin to give you a role.

comingSoon.body: This screen is on its way and will appear here once it's ready.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or it has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page couldn't load. Try again, and if it keeps happening, tell your school admin.

account.name: Name
